# How to collect Player Titles in Fallout 76

- Duchess Flame![Writer: Duchess Flame]()
- Dec 4, 2024
- 7 min read

Updated: Mar 28, 2025

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_954d35b1799f43fc931313c89bf128af~mv2.jpg)

Image Credit:

Player Titles offer a new way to showcase what makes your Vault Dweller unique. Using your Pip-Boy, you can mix and match prefixes and suffixes to create a nickname that fits your style. These titles can be earned by taking part in Public Events, Limited Time Events, completing Main Quests, and progressing through Seasons. They’re a great way to make your character stand out.

For veteran players, any titles connected to content you've already completed will be automatically added to your account.

Player Titles will show next to your GT/PSN/IGN while in-game on a team

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_15c710dca66746edbfb25cbf9b211ad1~mv2.jpg)

In your Pip-Boy

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_cbf7912807b841368f33766dbd84af9a~mv2.jpg)

Above your character

__How to apply Player Titles__

**Open your Pip-Boy to the STATS tab**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_9159a67cca4f49b0b756c560d2aacec6~mv2.jpg)

**On the STATS tab, scroll across past Collections to the new tab Prefix**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_d38afd4d12c54fc3be61552f9aa25bc4~mv2.jpg)

**Select your Prefix, and it will show at the bottom of your Pip-Boy**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_f4ddd2fa34294525b72570f55a315765~mv2.jpg)

**Scroll across again to Suffix**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_94a945bce03b4d7ab860db78ddbedcf0~mv2.jpg)

**Select your Suffix, and it will show at the bottom of your Pip-Boy**

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_28a847a824d14624b4f472353d31c775~mv2.jpg)

__How to obtain Player Titles__

**Plan:** A physical item that drops for the player, which they must "read" to unlock. This item is non-tradeable. Generally drops from Event.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_e6995b0deef046c695bfd7366f561ae2~mv2.jpg)

**Auto-Unlocked:** This is not a physical plan. Instead, it automatically unlocks the item. This item is non-tradeable. Generally unlocks via Quests or Lifetime Challenges.

![](https://static.wixstatic.com/media/586626_308400c9a89d4c368adae9d635689332~mv2.jpg)

__List of Player Titles__

Checklist can be found __here__.

Note: This list only contains the base game, Season, and Event Player Titles. It does not include any Atom Shop or Real World Money Bundle Player Titles.

### __A__

- **Abominable** (Prefix) Obtained by: Season 20 Scoreboard - Glow of the Ghoul
- **Adoring Fan** (Suffix) Obtained by: Lifetime Challenge: Explore Appalachia for 7600 Hours.
- **Adventurer** (Suffix) Obtained by: Default title granted to all players.
- **Appalachian** (Prefix) Obtained by: Default title granted to all players.
- **Avalon Scribe** (Suffix) Obtained by: Season 3 Season Pass - The Scribe of Avalon.

### __B__

- **Bold** (Prefix) Obtained by: Lifetime Challenge: Discover the Gleaming Depths.
- **Brotherhood Initiate** (Suffix) Obtained by: Complete Field Testing Quest.

- **Cannibal** (Suffix) Obtained by: Season 20 Scoreboard - Glow of the Ghoul
- **Carnivore** (Suffix) Obtained by: Completing Grahm's Meat Cook and reaching tier 3 "Best" rewards.
- **Cattle Rustler** (Suffix) Obtained by: Completing Free Range in any region, with all three Brahmin left alive at the end.
- **Chef** (Prefix) Obtained by: Lifetime Challenge: Learn Cooking Recipes.
- **Cold Steel** (Suffix) Obtained by: Season 4 Season Pass - Armor Ace in Cold Steel.
- **Commoner** (Suffix) Obtained by: Default title granted to all players.
- **Cultist** (Suffix) Obtained by: Completing The Mothman Equinox event with all three pyres undamaged at the end.
- **Cryptozoologist** (Prefix) Obtained by: Lifetime Challenge: Kill Different Kinds of Cryptids.

- **Drill Eradicator** (Suffix) Obtained by: Lifetime Challenge: Gleaming Depths - Defeat Drill Complex x76.
- **Drill Slayer** (Suffix) Obtained by: Lifetime Challenge: Gleaming Depths - Defeat Drill Complex x1.
